resolution.note: worktree add failure prunes worktrees and deletes the branch, then rethrows; regression test red without it.

title: A failed lane start leaves no branch behind
body:
Why: 2026-11-13 a krn lane start failed in git worktree add (config lock) after git had created the branch; every retry then refused with "branch <slug> already exists" until the lead deleted it by hand.
Outcome: a failed worktree add prunes and deletes the branch it created, so a retry starts the lane.
Proof: test/cli/lane.test.ts "a failed worktree add leaves no branch behind" red without the rollback (exit 1), green with it.
